name: Sea Change Harpoon
text: Silas Marsh deck only. [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. If you committed 1 or more skills to this skill test, this attack deals +1 damage. When this skill test ends, you may return Sea Change Harpoon to your hand to return all of your committed skill cards to your hand instead of discarding them.
text_cn: 赛拉斯‧马什牌组专用。 [action]：攻击。这次攻击你+1[combat]。如果你有投入技能卡到这次技能检定，这次攻击造成+1伤害。在这次技能检定结束时，你可以将骇变鱼叉返回你的手牌，来让所有你投入的技能卡都不丢弃，改为返回你的手牌。
